feedback: Concept is physically sound and buildable. Under-deck TMD tuned to 1.86 Hz for 1.9 Hz bending mode using Den Hartog optimum is correct model: f_opt=1/(1+mu)=0.98 gives 1.863 Hz, zeta_opt~0.084-0.086, k=(2pi f)^2 m ~54.8 kN/m for 400kg all match E4. 2% mass ratio implies ~20t modal mass which is plausible for 40m footbridge, and prior art DEICON 2x500kg concealed midspan TMD with 3x damping increase validates regime. Load path deck->frame->springs/dampers->mass is continuous, passive out-of-phase damping adds effective damping, no conservation violation. 3924N static, ~2.5MPa static + small dynamic stress and 4xM16 per module is non-critical, 8.2mm stroke vs 30mm clearance gives margin, below-soffit bolted cross-frames with no deck penetration preserves deck appearance and is ordinary shop/bolted work with purchasable springs/dampers/masses. Remaining detailed design -5% detune check to complement +5% 0.136 m/s2 /5.33mm, formal Eurocode fatigue check, spring catalog selection - does not block concept acceptance.
